sticky_map.name: Sticky map / a contextual map on a pinboard
sticky_map.description: A cork pinboard of sticky notes joined by red threads, drawn from commons/data/sticky_maps/<map>.json: the file the encyclopedia's /sticky-map edits and draws in three.js by the same rules. It watches the file and redraws within a second of a save. Origin on the floor under the middle of the board; the notes face +Z.
sticky_map.qfep_connection: A knowledge assemblage whose organisation remains open: arguments laid out in space, their relations threaded, rearranged where they are read.
